No Q4 or 2027 consensus found, so guidance-line findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest ~11.4M shares, ~3.0 days to cover as of 2026-09-30 settlement (https://massive.com/quote/mtch, via search snippet); ~4.8% of float, falling, 2026-08-20 (equibles snippet). Baseline: 25d skew -0.34 vol points (flat, 'balanced'), put/call OI 0.33 (call-heavy), ATM IV 60.9%, event-implied move 9.13%, run-up 5d -7.37% / 20d +3.84%, 10% off the 52w high. findings.finding: Q3 revenue bar sits inside the company's own guide: guide $885-895M (down 2-3% Y/Y, FXN down 1-2%, FX a one-point headwind), consensus $891.6M = guide midpoint; track record is mixed, Q1 2026 $864M beat the top of its $850-860M guide while Q2 $853M landed in the lower half of $850-860M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-04): revenue $853M vs ~$857M expected, small miss, stock -7.49% close-to-close with the soft Q3 guide; Q1 2026 (2026-05-05) revenue above guide, stock +0.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: consensus is at the guide midpoint. If the market expected a miss, consensus would sit in the lower half and the skew would be put-bid; it is flat (-0.34).

findings.finding: Profit line skews to a beat: Q3 adjusted EBITDA guided $330-335M (+10% Y/Y, 37% margin), FY EBITDA guided at-or-above the high end of $1,280-1,325M with margin above 37.5%, alternative-payment savings raised to ~$130M for the year from $110M assumed in February, SBC cut ~$20M, FCF at the high end; Q2 EPS $0.70 beat $0.65.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: EPS beat ($0.70 vs $0.65) and EBITDA +14% at 39% margin, stock still -7.49% on revenue and guide. This name has not paid for profit beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: consensus EPS $1.05 vs whisper $1.08 shows the street already expects a profit beat. If it were unpriced the whisper would sit at or below consensus.
findings.independence: Alt-payment savings ~$130M and FCF at high end also restated in the 2026-10-26 preview: https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter (same company source underneath).

findings.finding: Tinder DAU trajectory points to a first positive Y/Y month inside Q3/early Q4: Q2 -4% (best in 10 quarters), July -2.5% (company 8-K), August reported near flat (Earnings Whispers preview), management said DAU would turn positive 'any day now'; MAU still -7% and Tinder payers -5%, so the question is whether engagement reaches payers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: DAU improvement to -4% was disclosed with the print and the stock still fell 7.49% on payers and guide; Q1 2026: DAU -6%/-4% monthly with registrations turning positive, stock +0.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock rose ~21% from the post-Q2 low to $45.73 on exactly this trajectory and the preview is titled as putting the usage turn 'on trial'. What is not priced is whether September/October DAU actually printed positive and whether payers inflected; the 5-day -7.4% suggests some doubt crept in.
findings.independence: July -2.5% and 'positive any day now' in the company's own Q2 letter: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891103/000089110326000128/mtch8-k20260804ex992.htm ; GS Communacopia 2026-09-08 summary describes DAU 'improving trends': https://quartr.com/events/match-group-inc-mtch-goldman-sachs-communacopia-technology-conference-2026_3efEDCc1

findings.finding: Expectations were raised into the print: +21% since the Q2 report to a $46.67 high (vs S&P -2%), Evercore upgrade to Outperform with $53 PT on 2026-10-19, sentiment indicator moved to 'moderately bullish', call-heavy option book (put/call OI 0.33); the stock then gave back 7.4% in the five sessions to $41.88.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-08-05 print came after a run and rose +10.5%; 2026-08-04 print came near a 52w high ($41.40) and fell 7.49%. Mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is by definition in the price; the finding is that the bar for the Tinder turn is now higher than at the Q2 print. If the bar were low the stock would sit near the post-Q2 $37 rather than 13% above it; the last five sessions' -7.4% has already reversed about a third of the rally, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Rally and sentiment shift: https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter ; skew flat (-0.34) in the sealed baseline, so the option market does not lean either way.

findings.finding: Evergreen & Emerging is worse than first guided: E&E direct revenue now down mid-teens for FY (was low double digits), $15M Q3 hit from the Azar app redesign after store removal, indirect (ad) revenue -28% in Q2 and down mid-teens FY.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The E&E cut was part of the Q2 guide the stock fell 7.49% on (2026-08-05).
findings.why_not_priced: Inside the Q3 guide already, so mostly priced; the residual is whether Azar recovers or the hit extends into the Q4 guide. Net of the rest: Hinge (+22%, ~24% of revenue) offsets more than the E&E drag (~21% of revenue).
findings.independence: Same document as findings 1-2; Q2 reaction coverage naming E&E as a driver: https://finviz.com/news/377365/match-group-shares-tumble-as-revenue-miss-and-weak-outlook-overshadow-earnings-beat

findings.finding: Q4 guide arithmetic is soft: FY revenue 'near the midpoint' of $3,410-3,535M ($3,472.5M) less Q1 $864M, Q2 $853M and the Q3 midpoint $890M implies Q4 ~ $865M, a low-single-digit Y/Y decline; Tinder FY direct revenue still guided down low single digits and payers fell 6% in Q2. No Q4 consensus was found to compare against.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide drove the last two big moves: Q2 2026 soft Q3 guide -7.49%; Q4 2025 FY guide flat (2026-02-03) +5.92%; Q3 2025 (2025-11-04) +5.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Derived arithmetic, not a sourced bar; if the street's Q4 sits above ~$865M a reiterated FY would read as a cut. Capped small because the Q4 bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: Q1 actual: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891103/000089110326000072/mtch8-k20260505ex991.htm ; FY 'near midpoint': https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891103/000089110326000128/mtch8-k20260804ex992.htm (three company documents, one inference).
